Name: Trophie
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Meet Trophie, a handsome 65-pound Poodle/Labrador mix who lives up to his name—he’s a total prize! At around 6 years old, he has the perfect balance of fun, playful energy and sweet, gentle affection. Trophie's primary language is Spanish! He responds best to Spanish cues. Try these commands right here at his kennel to say hello and see how smart he is: "Sienta" (Slee-en-tah) –Sit "Ven" (Ven) – Come "Buen chico" (Bwen chee-koh) –Good boy "Hola, Trophie!" (Oh-lah) – Hello, Trophie! Because Trophie is as smart as he is pretty, word around the shelter is that he’s a bit of an escape artist. He’s just an adventurous, clever soul looking for his forever team! He’ll do best in a home with a secure yard and a family eager to speak his language while giving him all the love he deserves.Come meet Trophie today

Name: Sully - Adoption Fee Sponsored
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Sully is a handsome 3-year-old with a smile so big it’s impossible not to smile back! A long-term resident since August 2025, Sully is a true "people person" when it comes to adults. The moment he sees a friendly face, that famous grin appears, and his whole body lights up with excitement. This playful boy still has plenty of youthful energy and loves being part of the fun, whether he’s greeting you with happy wiggles or leaning in for some well-earned pets. Ideal Home: Adult-Oriented: Sully is looking for a mature household with children aged 13 and older. Younger children can be overwhelming for him, and he prefers a calm, predictable environment where he feels secure. Dog Selectivity: Sully is selective about his canine friends. In playgroups, he typically prefers smaller female dogs. If you have another dog at home, a meet-and-greet is required to ensure they are a good match. If you’re looking for a fun-loving, loyal companion with a heart of gold and a smile that can brighten your whole day, Sully is ready to meet you!
Dog_Attributes: Kids 13+, Active, Adult-Only Home Preferred, Affectionate, Friendly, Gentle, Meet and greet required, Playful

Name: Rebel
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Hi, I’m Rebel! I’m a young, energetic guy who loves to play, stay busy, and be part of the action. At about 50 pounds, I’m a great medium size — easy to handle, perfect for adventures, and just right for everyday life. I’ve also got the cutest little nub of a tail and a sweet face that’s guaranteed to melt your heart! I’m treat-motivated and eager to learn, which makes training fun and rewarding. I would thrive in an active home that enjoys walks, playtime, and continuing my training so I can be the best boy I can be. I love my toys and sometimes guard them because they’re very special to me. I’ll do best with a family who understands this behavior and is willing to help me work on sharing and trading games to build my confidence and good habits. If you’re looking for a fun, smart, and affectionate companion with a big personality in a perfectly sized package, I might be your guy!
Dog_Attributes: Playful, Quirky, Friendly, Active, Affectionate, Kids 13+

Name: Onix off-site at Mutts with Manners
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Hi! I’m Onix, and enthusiasm is kind of my thing! I’m a playful young girl with endless puppy energy and a joyful spirit. I get very excited during playtime and am still learning to slow down, but I’m eager to learn and ready for adventure. Speaking of learning, I'm at Mutts with Manners to hone my skills!

Name: Oreo - off-site at Mutts with Manners
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Hi, I’m Mustard! I’m a sleek black-and-white Terrier / American Pit Bull mix with lots of playful, puppy energy still left in me. I may look calm and relaxed in my kennel, but once I’m outside and with my people, my fun-loving personality really comes to life! I love to play and can get a little mouthy when I get excited, so I’ll do best with a family who’s ready to help me keep working on my manners. The good news? I’m very food-motivated, which makes training fun, rewarding, and a great way for us to bond. If you’re looking for a happy, energetic girl who’s ready for playtime, learning, and lots of love, I might be the perfect match for you!

Name: Odie- Off site Mutts with manners
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Hi, I’m Popeye! I’m a 4-year-old medium mixed-breed with a gorgeous coat—black and brown with a white, speckled chest. I’m very friendly and sweet and love people. I’m still working on my manners and can get excited and jump up, so I may need some guidance around smaller children. With time, patience, and consistency, I’ll do great and continue to improve.

Name: Pebbles - off site mutts with manners
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Don’t let that serious, soulful face fool you—underneath his regal brown eyes and stunning brindle coat, Pebbles is a total 2-year-old goofball! Dee’s absolute favorite thing in the world? Food! He is 100% treat-motivated and practically has "will work for snacks" written on his collar. Training this guy is going to be a breeze because if you have a treat in your hand, you have his undivided attention. His other favorite thing? You! In fact, getting a good photo of Dee is an extreme sport because every time you pull out a camera, he immediately trots over to stand right next to you instead of posing. He’d much rather give cuddles than model!

Name: Mo
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Mo is a gorgeous, 50-pound mixed breed girl with a big smile, an even bigger heart, and the most adorable squishy face! With her sweet tan-and-white coat and expressive eyes, she’s a total crowd-pleaser who brings instant joy everywhere she trots. Mo is the definition of a fun-loving companion. She adores playtime, loves soaking up outdoor sunshine, and has an absolute blast engaging with her favorite humans. Her bright, happy personality makes every day feel like a party, she’s always ready for a game of fetch, a brisk walk, or just sharing huge, happy grins. Because of her irresistible, squishy folds and loose skin, Mo will need a dedicated family who understands the art of wrinkle maintenance! Keeping those cute skin folds clean and dry with routine wipe-downs is key to keeping her comfortable and free from yeast irritation. It’s a tiny bit of extra care that pays off tenfold in endless love, silly antics, and loyal companionship. If you’re looking for a playful, sweet girl who will keep you laughing and smiling, Mo is ready to meet her forever match!

Name: Eight
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Hi, I’m Eight! I’ve had a bit of a tough journey getting here—I came to the shelter with a paw injury that took a lot of care, patience, and a small toe amputation surgery to heal. But guess what? I’m 100% officially cleared by the medical team and ready to find my forever family! Why You’ll Love Me: Brave & Resilient: Through all my vet visits and healing time, I’ve stayed a total sweetie. Puppy Spirit: Now that my paw is all healed up, I’m ready to romp, play, and explore! Sweet Family Pup: Just like my brother Ale, I have a big heart and so much love to give. Ideal Home: A loving family ready to spoil a brave pup who has put his tough start behind him and is ready for a lifetime of fun.

Name: Marley
Kennel_Card_Website_Memo: Marley can be a little timid when meeting someone new, but a few tasty bribes are always welcome to help ease those first-meeting jitters! This extra-fluffy boy has a wonderful personality just waiting to shine. He's goofy, bouncy, and always ready to strike a pose when the right treats are involved. Marley's beautiful coat will require regular grooming, which is a commitment worth considering before bringing him home. He may take a little more time and effort to keep looking his best, but I think you'll agree he's absolutely worth it!
